name: template-engine
description: Minimal zero-dependency string template engine supporting variable interpolation, conditionals ({{#if}}), and loops ({{#each}}).
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need simple Mustache/Handlebars-style template rendering without pulling in a full templating library. Suitable for generating HTML snippets, email bodies, configuration files, or any text with dynamic placeholders.

parameters.name: template
parameters.description: The template string containing {{variable}}, {{#if key}}, and {{#each array}} tags.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The data context object whose properties are used to resolve template variables.
